$comment: UCOS-AEE-001 — AUTONOMOUS EVOLUTION ENGINE (declaration). This file is DATA and is the
ONLY place the programme's vocabulary, principles, mandate sources, actuators,
observations, classification rules, decision values, convergence criteria, learning
dimensions and continuous-mode bindings are stated. aee_engine.py contains no actuator
name, no observation name, no owner path, no mandate identifier, no class name and no
decision name: everything it executes, measures, classifies and decides is read from
here. Adding an actuator, an observation, a classification rule, a decision value or a
convergence criterion is an append-only edit to this file and requires NO engine change.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME ADDS, AND WHY IT IS NOT A SECOND HOME FOR AN EXISTING CAPABILITY.
Every phase of the evolution loop already has a located, certified owner in this
repository, and this programme creates none of them. It creates no validator, no gate,
no registry, no schema, no measurement and no certification. What no located programme
owned is the CLOSED LOOP itself: every entry point in the repository is a one-shot
process, so nothing re-executed the located owners, re-read their sealed determinations,
compared consecutive readings, and asserted a fixed point over the OBSERVATION VECTOR.
This programme is that driver and only that driver. Its authority is NONE.
KNOWLEDGE ONCE. The loop's phases are not restated here. They are READ at run time from
the located declarations that already own them (see mandate_sources). Every actuator and
every observation binds itself to those phases by identifier, and --check-declaration
fails closed if a bound identifier does not resolve in the located source. A phase added
to a mandate source is therefore discovered here automatically and, if nothing discharges
it, is surfaced as an uncovered mandate rather than silently ignored.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO. It does not execute the repository
fixed-point gate. UCOS-RFP-001 owns that condition, requires a clean committed tree to
begin (RFP CLO-01), and runs the aggregate certifier as one of its own pipeline stages.
A driver that emits artifacts cannot assert a clean tree over itself, and a driver that
invoked the fixed-point engine which invokes the aggregate certifier would reproduce the
CYC-RECURSE topology RFP exists to forbid. AEE's convergence is over the observation
vector; byte-level repository closure remains RFP's, measured by its own gate in CI.
This scope boundary is recorded as a finding, not left implicit.

programme.name: Autonomous Evolution Engine
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme legislates nothing, registers nothing, certifies nothing and owns no capability. It sequences located owners, reads their sealed determinations, and asserts convergence over what they report.
programme.$reentrancy_comment: UCOS-RFP-001 exports this variable while its pipeline is active. This engine refuses to run when it is set, which is what keeps the driver out of the fixed-point engine's own pipeline (RFP CYC-RECURSE).

$vocabulary_comment: The programme's normative vocabulary. Each term is DEFINED here and referenced by identifier from the principles, the convergence criteria and the emitted reports.

vocabulary.definition: A located, already-owned executable that this programme invokes in order to REGENERATE a sealed determination. An actuator is never authored by this programme and never validates anything on its behalf.

A single measured reading taken from a located owner's own sealed output, addressed by a dotted pointer and compared against a declared expectation by a generic operator. An observation performs no analysis of its own; it reports what its owner already determined.
The ordered tuple of every observation's measured verdict in one iteration. It is the object over which this programme asserts a fixed point.
An observation whose measured value violates its declared expectation. A finding is discovered, never listed by hand: the set of findings is a function of the located owners' sealed outputs.
A loop phase or standing obligation READ from a located declaration that already owns it. Mandates are never restated in this file.
One complete pass of actuation followed by observation, classification and decision.
The state in which consecutive iterations produce an identical observation vector and every blocking criterion is satisfied. Convergence is measured, never asserted.

A working-tree entry appearing during an iteration. Residue is ATTRIBUTED to the actuator whose declared write zone contains it; residue that no declared write zone explains is unattributed and blocks convergence.

The deterministic persistence of what an iteration established — measured values, exercised write zones, assigned classes and decisions, and the iteration at which stability was reached — so a later run resolves an identical finding by lookup instead of rediscovery. It is a knowledge projection, not a statistical model.
A standing, located finding that bounds the verdict this programme may assert without itself failing the gate. A ceiling is disclosed; it is never silently dropped.

$principle_comment: The permanent principles. AEE-1 is the loop obligation. AEE-2..AEE-6 are the admission rules that keep the loop constitutional. AEE-7..AEE-8 bind and inherit. Each names the located instrument that already enforces it.

principle.principle: The loop is closed. Actuation is followed by observation, observation by classification, classification by decision, and the whole by a measured comparison against the previous iteration. A pass that does not compare itself to its predecessor is not an iteration.

Zero new authority. Every actuator is a located owner's own entry point and every observation reads a located owner's own sealed output. This programme adds no validator, gate, registry, schema or certification.
Zero enumeration. No actuator, observation, mandate, class, decision or owner path appears as a literal in the engine source, so extension is an edit to this declaration alone.
Own memory only. Every byte this programme writes lands inside its own operational home. Actuators write their owners' homes because they ARE those owners; this programme writes nobody else's.
Absence of evidence is never evidence. A required actuator that did not execute, and an observation whose pointer does not resolve, are failures — never silent passes.

Determinism. The emitted set is a function of the repository alone: no timestamp, no duration, no commit identity and no absolute path is recorded, so regeneration at an unchanged tree is byte-identical.
Byte-level repository closure is not this programme's to assert. It belongs to the fixed-point owner and is measured by that owner's own gate.
Classification and decision are derived from declared rules over mechanically derived properties of a finding. No finding is classified by hand and none is left without a class and a decision.

$tier_comment: Ordered execution tiers. A tier includes every actuator at or below it. 'observe' actuates nothing and is the fast read-only pass; 'standard' runs the light actuators; 'closure' adds the heavy aggregate certifier, which itself runs verification, determinism and the registration-drift gate.
$mandate_sources_comment: The loop's phases and standing obligations are READ from these located declarations.
They are NOT restated in this file — that is what makes the binding verifiable rather
than decorative. 'collection_pointer' selects a member of a keyed collection when the
source holds several pipelines; 'member_pointer' names the ordered phase array;
'id_field' and 'label_field' name the identifier and human label within each member.
A phase appended to any source is discovered on the next run with no edit here.

$class_comment: The classification values. This programme adds none: the register is owned by EVOLUTION-001 §2 and every value below is that register's, referenced by name so a finding's class is always a located constitutional value.
$decision_comment: The decision values available to the decision engine. 'requires_evidence' marks a decision that may not be recorded without naming the located instrument or owner that justifies it.

$classification_rule_comment: Ordered rules; the FIRST whose predicate matches assigns the class and the decision.
Predicates are evaluated over properties DERIVED mechanically from the finding — never
over its identity — which is what makes classification automatic rather than manual.
Available derived properties: 'blocking' (the observation blocks convergence),
'governed' (a located finding already governs the observation), 'escalated' (the
governing finding is declared non-engineering-closable), and 'actuator_failure' (the
finding is a required actuator's non-zero exit rather than a reading).
The final rule carries an empty predicate and is therefore total: no finding can fall
through unclassified, which is what CONV-05 measures.

classification_rules.rationale: A required located owner failed to execute. The loop cannot read a determination that was never produced, so the failure is a defect in the executable path and closes by engineering.

The governing finding records that no located authority is competent to close the subject. An engineering act cannot discharge a vacancy of authority, so the finding leaves engineering scope and stands as a disclosed ceiling.

A located owner has already registered this gap and holds the work package that closes it. Acting here would create a second home for a disposition that is already owned, so the finding waits on its owner and on nothing else.

A blocking expectation that no located finding governs was satisfied by construction when the expectation was declared. Its violation is therefore a regression against Repository Truth and closes by engineering.
Total residual rule. A non-blocking, ungoverned reading is a real but unprioritised divergence; it is recorded with a class and a decision so that nothing is discovered and then dropped.

$convergence_comment: The measured conditions of the loop's fixed point. Every criterion is MEASURED; 'expect' is the only accepted value. 'required_stable_iterations' is how many consecutive iterations must produce an identical observation vector before convergence may be asserted — one pass proves nothing about stability.

$learning_comment: What an iteration retains so a later run resolves an identical finding by lookup rather than rediscovery. The ledger is a generated, deterministic projection: it carries no timestamp and no commit identity, so an unchanged repository regenerates it byte-identically.

dimensions.retains: the measured value and verdict of every declared observation at the terminal iteration, keyed by observation identifier
the residue each actuator actually produced, so a declared write zone that is never exercised is visible as over-declaration
the class, decision and matched rule every finding received, so an identical finding is never re-adjudicated from scratch
the iteration index at which the observation vector became stable, and the vector digest at every iteration
the mandate universe read from the located sources and which actuator or observation discharges each member, so an uncovered phase is surfaced rather than assumed

$continuous_comment: Cadence. The repository contains no resident process, no scheduler and no daemon, and its
session hooks are deliberately frozen. Inventing one would be new, unadjudicated surface,
so this programme does not. Cadence is bound to the authorities that already provide it:
continuous integration on every push and pull request, and the operator-invocable targets.
The standing obligations themselves are not restated here — they are READ from the located

cadence_owners.note: A gate a programme must enrol in is a gate the next programme forgets; this one runs unconditionally.
The same predicate CI runs, reachable locally, so the loop is never a CI-only artefact.

closure_authority.note: Byte-level repository closure is asserted by this owner's own gate over a clean committed tree. This programme never invokes it, which is what keeps the driver out of the fixed-point engine's pipeline.

$findings_comment: Dispositioned findings of this programme itself. A finding recorded here narrows what the programme may claim; it is never a way to pass the gate. 'engineering_closable' false means no act inside this repository can discharge it — the decision engine reads this property to reach ESCALATE rather than inventing work that cannot succeed.

findings.title: A certification ceiling stands: the aggregate certifier reports standing located findings
findings.note: The ceiling is a union: one component is a measured traceability gap owned by a located work package, the other is a vacancy of ratifying authority. The vacancy cannot be closed by any act inside this repository, so the composite ceiling is not engineering-closable and this programme discloses it instead of asserting an unqualified verdict.

findings.title: Convergence here is over the observation vector, not over the repository's bytes
findings.note: Byte-level closure requires a clean committed tree to begin and runs the aggregate certifier as one of its own stages. A driver that emits artifacts cannot assert cleanliness over itself, and invoking the fixed-point engine from here would rebuild the recursion topology that engine exists to forbid. The condition is not weakened, only owned elsewhere and measured by its own gate.

findings.title: Cadence is bound to continuous integration, not to a resident process
findings.note: No resident process, scheduler or armed session hook exists anywhere in this repository, and the hooks that did exist were deliberately disarmed. A daemon would be unadjudicated surface. The loop therefore runs on every push and on operator invocation, which is the cadence authority the repository actually has.
